verdict.rationale: Svelte's own materials say it is a compiler that turns declarative components into efficient JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM, doing minimal work in the browser [svelte-gh-1, svelte-docs-1, svelte-docs-4]. Developers update state as plain variables with no manual update code [svelte-docs-5], and community users back the compile-to-imperative-JS approach, citing snappy performance and readable generated code [svelte-comm-15, svelte-comm-5, svelte-comm-8]. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation or benchmarks of the compiled DOM-update output, given one user report that rendering becomes a bottleneck at large scale (Svelte 4) [svelte-comm-10].
